title: Viracocha and Lake Titicaca as a mirror civilization of Lake Van
place_text: Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku, Puma Punku, Bolivia/Peru

tellings.quote: Bolivia we have vosha holding the two Condors on either side which I think is the same concept you see in front of you of the pillars of holding balance

plain: The ancient culture around Lake Titicaca in Bolivia and Peru, with its ruined sites of Tiwanaku and Puma Punku, is said to mirror an ancient civilization around Lake Van in Turkey. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels, without naming a source, that the Andean creator figure Viracocha is shown in Bolivia holding two condors, one on either side, which he reads as the same idea as the pillars "holding balance" he sees in the Lake Van region. If true, it would point to a shared ancient tradition on two continents.
